name: Improved Primal Defense
body:
You can wear minimal armor as a second skin, undaunted and unhindered as always.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, Primal Defense, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): You can gain the benefits of the Primal Defense feat even when wearing light armor.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
